hintroom.level7.choir: Three waves, then four levers to pull almost together, one each.
hintroom.level7.dyke: The warden slams the ground and charges. Take cover behind the pillars.
hintroom.level7.glassheart: Morvane's echo awaits. Take cover behind the pillars and dodge!
hintroom.level7.mirrorpools: The red hero reads the runes, the blue one lights the bridge. Call out the sequence!
hintroom.level7.pearlcave: Dark room: each hero lights their brazier, the red hero keeps watch in the pearl.
hintroom.level7.shoal: Each hero holds their coloured plate to open the door. Avoid the basins!
hintroom.level7.sluice: Push the block to the socket, then hold both plates at the same time.
hintroom.level7.stormdeck: A flying wraith guards the deck. Take cover behind the masts!
level.level7.intro.1: Beneath the pearly waters, a drowned chime is still calling.
level.level7.intro.2: Listen... The missing fragment sleeps at the bottom of this sunken city.
level.level7.intro.3: It is not lost. It was drowned.
level.level7.intro.4: Then we dive in. Together, as always.
level.level7.name: The Drowned Chime
level.level7.outro.1: The fragment finally pulses. A pink glow, far away to the east.
level.level7.outro.2: Every fragment you take back has a reflection.
objective.level7.pearl: Keep watch in the pearl for 20 s
room.level7.choir.name: The Mother-of-Pearl Choir
room.level7.dyke.name: The Warden's Dyke
room.level7.glassheart.name: The Glass Heart
room.level7.mirrorpools.name: The Mirror Pools
room.level7.pearlcave.name: The Pearl Cave
room.level7.shoal.name: The Shallows
room.level7.sluice.name: The Sluice
room.level7.stormdeck.name: The Storm Deck
sign.level7.choir.door: The sanctuary door opens when all four levers are pulled almost together.
sign.level7.choir.levers: Four coloured levers around the ring: one each, within the 10 s window.
sign.level7.choir.waves: Three waves await. Advance band by band and clear each one.
sign.level7.dyke.cover: Pillars stop projectiles. A well-placed special buys you time.
sign.level7.dyke.warden: The dyke warden: ground slam, charge, minions. Stay together!
sign.level7.glassheart.cover: Pillars stop projectiles. The sealed exit opens when it falls.
sign.level7.glassheart.morvane: Morvane's echo: fans, bursts, summons. Keep moving!
sign.level7.mirrorpools.bridge: The blue hero carries the lantern: outside its light, the bridge does not exist.
sign.level7.mirrorpools.east: The door opens once the sequence is played. An ambush waits to the east.
sign.level7.mirrorpools.pedestals: On the island, five pedestals. Strike them (Action) in the called order.
sign.level7.mirrorpools.reader: The rune screen: only the red hero can read it. Call out the sequence!
sign.level7.pearlcave.braziers: Four coloured braziers in the corners: each hero lights theirs to open the door.
sign.level7.pearlcave.dark: Dark room: a lit brazier refuels your torch (Action).
sign.level7.pearlcave.pearl: The pearl: the red hero must keep watch there 20 s (total) to open the exit.
sign.level7.shoal.basins: The basins trap walkers: go around them, they are bottomless.
sign.level7.shoal.bones: The green hero must land 3 killing blows on skeletons. Give them a chance!
sign.level7.shoal.plates: Four coloured plates: each hero holds theirs, all at once.
sign.level7.sluice.block: The block only moves pushed by two, straight to the socket. Guardians lurk!
sign.level7.sluice.galleries: The north and south galleries are dotted with bottomless basins. Guardians ahead.
sign.level7.sluice.plates: Pump and tide: hold both plates together, socket filled, to open the door.
sign.level7.stormdeck.masts: Masts stop projectiles. The exit opens when the wraith falls.
sign.level7.stormdeck.wraith: A flying wraith: it vanishes, reappears and fires dark bolts. Take cover!
